title: Technical Communications Designer
note: Layout of grill manuals, assembly guides and warning labels in InDesign; open to 0–3 years of experience.

facts.summary: Designer producing technical documentation for Weber Blackstone grills.
facts.duties: Lay out user manuals, assembly guides, operational graphics and labels in Adobe CC; meet regulatory/language requirements; release print-ready PDFs.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's degree, 0–3 years in technical/graphic design or writing, InDesign, Illustrator, Acrobat, strong typography and layout.
facts.apply: Apply on Weber's Workday careers site.
